lede: Wat Nong Bua accounts for 33 catalogued manuscripts, 13 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (79%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (21%). Dated witnesses run 1883–1933 CE (4 of 33 carry a date).
